generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders should abide by other terms and conditions as per tender document attached.
The Authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all tenderers without giving any reasons.

itemList.description:
Part-A - Regular maintenance
Carrying out the Pump/valve operation for 65HP DWVT pumpset at Jackwell cum pumphouse & regular oiling for DWVT Pumpsets, periodical greasing for pumpsets, maintaining log books and allied works as per water supply schedules for maintaining smooth water supply at Kushalnagar pumphouse by engaging minimum 3 person pump operators to complete the assigned job work for the period of 5 months and as per the directions of Engineer incharge.
The manpower payment as per latest Minimum wages act (GOK) order. The rate is inclussive of Basic Salary, D.A, E.S.I-3.25%, E.P.F-12% & PF admin charges-0.5%, EDL charges @ 0.5%.

Carrying out the operation of 1.5MLD and 2.27MLD capacity water treatment plant maintenance like cleaning WTP components and WTP premises, backwash of filter bed, inlet & outlet valve operation, flocculation, filtration, chlorination and all allied works as per water supply schedules & 25HP C/F pure water pumpset at WTP like periodical greasing for pumpsets, maintaining log books and allied works as per water supply schedules for maintaining smooth water supply at Kushalnagar WTP by engaging minimum 6 person operators to complete the assigned job work for the period of 5 months and as per the directions of Engineer incharge. 
The manpower payment as per latest Minimum wages act (GOK) order. The rate is inclusive of Basic Salary, DA, ESI-3.25%, EPF -12%, PF admin charges-0.5%, EDL charges @ 0.5%.

Carrying out the rectification of leakages in feeder mains, distribution network pipelines and valves etc., and all allied works as per water supply schedules for maintaining smooth water supply to Kushalnagar town by engaging minimum 2 person plumbers to complete the assigned job work for the period of 5 months and as per the directions of Engineer in charge. 
The manpower payment as per latest Minimum wages act (GOK) order. The rate is inclusive of Basic Salary, DA, ESI-3.25%, EPF -12%, PF admin charges-0.5%, EDL charges @ 0.5%.

Carrying out the disribution, feeder line valve operation, assisting in rectification of leakages in pipelines and valves and all allied works as per water supply schedules by engaging minimum number of manpower for O&M of rising main & gravity feeder mains to ensure stipulated qunatity of water supply to all the consumers for maintaining smooth water supply at Kushalnagar town by engaging minimum 1 person valveman to complete the assigned job works for the period of 5 months and as per the directions of Engineer incharge.
The manpower payment as per latest Minimum wages act (GOK) order. The rate is inclusive of Basic Salary, DA, ESI-3.25%, EPF -12%, PF admin charges-0.5%, EDL charges @ 0.5%.

Carrying out the meter reading, issue of bills, door to door water charges collection and preparation of DCB statement and maintenance water supply related ledgers etc.,by engaging minimum 3 person water charges collector, 1 person computer operator and to complete the assigned job works for the period of 5 months and as per the directions of Engineer incharge. 
The manpower payment as per latest Minimum wages act (GOK) order. The rate is inclusive of Basic Salary, DA, ESI-3.25%, EPF -12%, PF admin charges-0.5%, EDL charges @ 0.5%.

Provision for duties during Govt. Holidays, leave and in Jackwell cum pumphouse in night shift (one person at a time on shift basis) as supporting staff to night shift as safety measures, Duties in over night on interruption of water supply due to pipe burst (Raw/Pure water rising/gravity main), duties of valveman, duties during flood / drought situation for tanker water supply, cleaning of WTP components, overhead tanks & pure water sump as per Labour department notification No.KAE 106 LWA 2021, Bengaluru dated:28-07-2022
The manpower payment as per latest Minimum wages act (GOK) order. The rate is inclusive of Basic Salary, DA, ESI-3.25%, EPF -12%, PF admin charges-0.5%,EDL charges @ 0.5%.

Supplying of Poly Aluminium Chloride (PAC) - Coagulant agent to Kushalanagara Treatment plant required for treatment of water for 5 months. The rate is inclussive of transportation, loading, unloading, stacking charges with all lead and lift as directed by Engineer in charge.

Supplying of Liquid chlorine - disinfectant agent to Kushalanagara Treatment plant required for treatment of water for 5 months. The rate is inclussive of transportation, loading, unloading, stacking charges with all lead and lift as directed by Engineer in charge.

Supplying of bleaching powder to Kushalanagara Treatment plant required for treatment of water for 5 months. The rate is inclussive of transportation, loading, unloading, stacking charges with all lead and lift as directed by Engineer in charge.

Supply of SAE 10 oil as oil lubricant for 2 nos of 65HP DWVT pumpset at Jackwell cum pumphouse in Kushalanagar Town required for 5 months. The rate is inclussive of transportation, loading, unloading, stacking charges with all lead and lift as directed by Engineer in charge.

Conducting water quality test for raw water and pure water samples for physical, chemical and biological parameters as per CPHEEO standards for once in a week for 5 months in ISO certified laboratory and submission of report with all lead and lift as directed by Engineer in charge.

Conducting turbidity, pH and residual chlorine tests and conducting jar test on daily basis at WTP laboratory as per CPHEEO standards by using required reagents chemicals consumables with all lead and lift as directed by Engineer in charge. Number of test 3 samples per day.
